claims.harm: removing exceptions from the low-level file primitive and folding them into a nullptr return loses failure cause and context and expands an ambiguous nullable contract
claims.quote: removing exceptions from the low level file primitive and folding it into a `nullptr` is the wrong direction.

claims.harm: merging without resolving follow-up architectural questions leaves inconsistent handling of rare filesystem exceptions across execution paths
claims.quote: I don't think the pull will be merged as-is. Even if it was merged, there'd be a bunch of follow-ups, so it would be good to decide how to address them before merge.

claims.harm: lock order assertion failure in blockmanager unit tests when run with DEBUG_LOCKORDER
claims.quote: Assertion failed: lock ::cs_main not held in node/blockstorage.cpp:1138

claims.harm: adding nodiscard to block storage functions whose return values must naturally be consumed adds unnecessary verbosity and code bloat
claims.quote: Personally I don't think we should be adding `[[nodiscard]]` to all those functions, because this is extra verbosity/bloat

claims.harm: in unsupported test environments where file permissions cannot be simulated, tests silently pass without executing assertions, creating false coverage
claims.quote: in unsupported environments, the assertions never run, but the tests still pass. This can create false-positive test coverage.
